bio.text: David Crowley, a Democrat, is serving his second term as Milwaukee County Executive; he was first elected in 2020 as the youngest person and the first Black person to hold the office.
He was elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly in 2016 at age 30, representing Milwaukee, and served until 2020, when he was elected county executive.
Crowley announced his campaign for governor on September 9, 2025, and the Wisconsin Examiner's primary voter guide marks him as the winning candidate in the August 2026 Democratic primary.
The Associated Press reported in 2025 that he had pursued a college degree at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee and graduated while serving as county executive.

sources.title: David Crowley joins the race for Wisconsin governor
